title: Chapter 223: The Battlefield Of Star-Level Troops
content:
Chapter 223: The Battlefield Of Star-Level Troops

Nearly half of the Zerg Destroyer troops are still of average strength. Even though their attacks are very efficient in killing the skeleton army, despite the strength gap, many skeleton warriors still rushed to the front of the Naga army.

Some of them are two-star and three-star skeleton warriors. Through the perception of Host No. 3, Wu Qing even sensed the existence of a small number of four-star skeleton warriors.

These high-star skeleton warriors contain a large amount of energy in their bones, which can form an energy protective layer on their bones for a long time to enhance their defense and combat capabilities.

The explosive attack of liquid fireball shells of ordinary Zerg Destroyers has a much weaker killing effect on these high-star skeleton warriors.

The Naga warriors, who had already been in full health for a long time, faced the charging skeleton warriors and faced them fearlessly!

Naga seemed to have anticipated this situation. The Naga warriors in the front row were all powerful warriors. They fought against those high-star skeleton warriors and did not lose at all!

When high-star powerhouses fight, both sides' attacks and defenses have energy added to them. Ordinary troops without energy protection can only be massacred on such a battlefield and will not play much role.

The Naga warriors have superb martial arts skills, and the skeleton warriors have rich combat experience. The swords and shields of both sides intersect, and the fight is inextricable.

Although the fighting was fierce, the actual casualties on both sides were very few.

The fighting at the front was not over, so the soldiers at the rear could only stand in formation and were unable to take action.

"Don't worry about the enemies rushing over, just keep blasting from behind!"

Nagaya said to Host No. 3.

The Zerg Destroyer's attack did not dare to get too close to the Naga army. The splash of corrosive liquid produced by the explosion made no difference between friend and foe.

As the skeleton army charges, the Zerg destroyers can only attack the rear of the skeleton army.

The Naga warriors at the rear of the Naga army continued to support the frontline operations with bows and arrows.

After the attack by the Zerg Destroyers, the available strength of the Skeleton Army has been reduced by more than half, especially the long-range attack troops, which have not yet played any role.

When the two armies were fighting, the gap between plus and minus was too great. The skeleton warriors who rushed up were immediately besieged by the Naga warriors who had an absolute advantage in strength.

The Zerg Destroyers continued to attack the skeleton warriors and long-range troops behind the skeleton army. The long-range skeleton archers and skeleton mages had less defensive capabilities than the skeleton warriors and suffered greater damage.

In addition, the skeleton army's long-range troops were not many, so even if they entered the effective attack range, they still failed to launch an effective attack on the Naga army.

If the fight continues like this, the long-range arms of the skeleton army will be destroyed by the Zerg destroyers!

Host No. 3 suddenly felt a terrifying energy wave appear in the sky above the Zerg Destroyer. Just as it was about to form some kind of attack, it caused damage.

Wu Qing knew that a strong man from the Skeleton Clan had taken action. This kind of strong man who could control external energy to carry out large-scale attacks was either extremely powerful or used magical techniques that consumed faith energy or divine power.

The Naga tribe is also protected by strong men, so they can directly interrupt. The two sides should be opponents at the same level.

This is what Wu Qing is worried about. In the outside world, there is no corresponding high-end power to protect you. The strong enemies will not be moral to you and will take action when they want to.

The impact of the strong man's action is very great, and in many cases it can directly determine the outcome of a war. If the Zerg fights against such an enemy, it is just consuming resources and is completely meaningless.

After a secret confrontation between the Skeleton Tribe and the Naga Tribe, the strong men did not take action again. If Host No. 3 had not had a strong sense of perception, Wu Qing would not have known about this secret danger.

Several more rounds of attacks by the Zerg Destroyers fell on the Skeleton Army. The long-range troops of the Skeleton Army were either dead or injured and had completely lost their combat effectiveness.

The melee skeleton warriors of the skeleton army were hit hard by the long-range attacks of the Zerg destroyers and Naga warriors. At the same time, they also lost the support of their own long-range troops. They were no match for the Naga warriors who were equally powerful. , there were a lot of casualties.

The skeleton mage commander, who had been staying put like Nagaya, suddenly gave the order to retreat.

The surviving skeleton warriors quickly broke away from the battle and quickly evacuated to the rear.

During this process, the long-range attacks of the Zerg Destroyers and Naga Warriors continued, constantly killing the retreating skeleton warriors.

The powerful skeleton warriors have really strong defense capabilities. Under such constant attacks, many skeleton warriors still successfully retreated, all the way out of the attack range of the Zerg destroyers.

The Zerg Destroyer's attacks continued, and they continued to attack a large number of injured and undead Skeleton soldiers on the battlefield.

The energy in living things has endless uses. With energy, there are endless possibilities. Many skeleton soldiers use energy to protect the soul fire in their skulls, and they can survive being injured. As long as they are rescued by their companions, it won't take long. They will be restored to their original state.

Therefore, as long as the skeleton soldiers on the battlefield do not turn into light and disappear, the Zerg destroyers will continue to attack. They will not stop attacking until only the bodies of the skeleton soldiers shot to death by the Naga warriors are left on the battlefield.

After this battle, the original participating forces of both sides were just over 100,000. The Naga army destroyed 60,000 to 70,000 Skeleton soldiers at the cost of losing a very small number of Naga warriors.

These are all soldiers with at least one-star strength, and there are also many two-star, three-star and four-star elite forces, which are not comparable to ordinary armies.

Wu Qing felt a little regretful for not completely annihilating the enemy.

Host No. 3 flew down and flew to Naga's side, saying: "It's a pity that I didn't do my best!"

Naga didn't care at all and seemed very happy.

She explained to Host No. 3: "You know, it is very difficult to destroy a large number of enemies in a battlefield with equal strength and equal manpower for a star-level soldier. Sometimes, both sides may not lose much manpower after a whole day of fighting!"

"If you hadn't joined the battle, it would have been a great achievement to destroy tens of thousands of enemies by night!"

"We have to pay the same price ourselves!"

"Such a battlefield is a war of attrition. Both sides are trying to maintain and destroy the balance!"

"Your participation in the war has destroyed the balance. Now the Skeleton Tribe will have a headache for a while!"

"Wait a minute, the chief elder of the tribe should come to us to talk about this. We must seize this opportunity to consume more of the Skeleton Tribe's power!"

The Naga army won a great victory and went forward to clean up the battlefield and transported back the skeletons left on the battlefield. The bones of the Skeleton Tribe that contain energy are very good materials.

In this war, the Zerg destroyers were the main force in killing the enemy. In addition to the part close to the Naga army, there were some spoils of war. At a farther distance, the dead Skeleton soldiers either disappeared in light or were corroded beyond recognition by the corrosive mucus.

The Naga warriors were also harmed by the corrosive mucus. They did not enter the areas attacked by the Zerg destroyers. Those places were full of corrosive mucus, which was corroding the ground and would not disappear for a while.

The battlefield was simply cleaned up, and the war that was originally planned to be fought for a day ended early.

This is a mature battlefield in the main battlefield of the camp war. Both sides have a tacit understanding that after this battle, there will be no enemies to fight. If they continue to act arbitrarily, it will disrupt the entire situation and be disadvantageous to both sides.

The big clan will consider more things. Not only do they have to consider how to kill the enemy, but they also have to consider their own status as a big clan. If they blindly bury their heads in killing the enemy like a reckless man, they may exhaust their own foundation in an instant and eventually become cannon fodder in the camp war!

Wu Qing also understood this truth. In such a battlefield exclusive to the big clan, he did not continue to shout and kill, and everything was arranged by Naga.

As Naga said, not long after, a female Naga with an extraordinary temperament came and found Naga and Host No. 3.

This Naga should have a very high status. Naga respectfully called her "elder", and Host No. 3 also called her "elder".

Perhaps because Host No. 3's status was not enough, Naga did not introduce the two parties, but just listened respectfully and waited for the person to speak.

Host No. 3, who was possessed by Wu Qing, did not say anything, and waited with Naga.

The visitor looked at Host No. 3 and the Zerg Destroyer not far away, and said, "Not bad, but a little weak!"

"Naga, you have made an indelible contribution to this matter. I hope you will continue to work hard!"

"The Zerg has just entered the world and is in a period of rapid development. Our two tribes should interact more and deepen exchanges. I hope you can gain the status of a major tribe as soon as possible!"

The visitor commented and said something to Naga and Host No. 3 respectively.

"Yes!"

Naga replied respectfully.

Wu Qing responded through Host No. 3: "This is an honor for my tribe!"

"You keep busy."

The visitor turned around and left without saying anything more.

Through the perception of Host No. 3, Wu Qing felt that this powerful elder of the Naga tribe was at the same level as the Goblin elder Gong Rui, and was very powerful.

As soon as the Zerg came out, they could meet strong people everywhere, which made Wu Qing more eager to develop the Zerg.

After the powerful elder of the Naga tribe left, Naga said to Host No. 3: "Do you have stronger Zerg destroyers? If possible, we need to hire a large number of your Zerg destroyers!"

"If this is done, our tribe will definitely launch a powerful offensive against the Skeleton Tribe and strive to seize the initiative on the battlefield in one fell swoop!"

"By then, the relationship between our two tribes will be further improved. If you want to gain the status of a great tribe, as long as you are strong enough, our tribe will definitely support you with all your strength!"
